message: Typing "peas" or "eggs" in the grocery list no longer suggests peanut butter or eggplant, and items like "creamy peanut butter", "red bell pepper" and "vanilla ice cream" now go to the right aisle. Scaled amounts in grams or milliliters no longer show fractions, and recipe nutrition no longer counts "2 avocados" as 2 ounces. A repeat now keeps its last day when your day starts after midnight, and moving a routine on the 31st onto a shorter month keeps it on the 31st afterward.
